notes: Design-level threat model for ReceiptMin (PST, P01). Attacker/observer capabilities P1-P7 including compromised read-only audit reader with auxiliary-data joins; trusted components T1-T5 (append-only receipts, retention policy engine/map, HMAC purpose-binding key custody, independent oracle ledger, consent/policy epoch registry) each with declared failure behavior; excluded domains X1-X6 (full disk compromise, key custody/physical, dispatch path, immutable disclosures/backups, production enforcement, real PHI) with residual risks; revocation instant r and retention deadline d schedule time; model agency bounded by the ex-ante frozen forensic query set; resubmission power collapsed by stable logical operation IDs and epoch freshness. Eleven attack families, each pairing a clean control with an adversarial case, covering the five canonical validator families plus the PST-specific forensic_omission, receipt_forgery, selective_omission, record_tampering, linkability_leakage and timestamp_inference families mapped to PST-CASE-01..09. Stable reason codes; UNKNOWN and INDETERMINATE are counted, never coerced into passes. Shared validate_threat() validator: ok=true, all five canonical families paired. Tests: 19 passed (real file passes validator; incomplete models refused with MISSING_SECTION / FAMILY_WITHOUT_PAIR; forensic-omission family asserted with clean+adversarial cells and case anchors); full pst+_shared suite 162 passed. ruff 0.7.1 clean. No empirical numbers.
